name: Calçotades
desc: Catalonia's winter ritual, adopted by the island: charred calçots (sweet spring onions) eaten with the hands, dipped in romesco, followed by meat off the grill and wine from a porró. Sunday lunch, long, messy, wonderful.

name: Almond blossom
desc: The Pla de Corona above Santa Agnès turns white for two or three weeks; the whole island drives up on the first sunny Sunday. Walk it from the village at golden hour, or do the Es Plans loop.

name: Oysters & open fire — The Oyster Nomad × Hot Boy
desc: A travelling oysterman in a top hat and a cook on an open-fire grill, taking over a restaurant for one night. Last seen at Sa Carboneria on 10 October: the naked one (6,5), fresh & juicy with ponzu and pomegranate (7,5), surf & turf with smoked solomillo tartare (8,5), the champagne room (10), or all four for 29. Umami oysters, AIX rosé. Next dates on the agenda as they're confirmed.

where.n: Book them for your own table

alt: The Oyster Nomad and Hot Boy behind the counter at Sa Carboneria, Ibiza, 10 October 2026

name: Cheese fondue & live music
desc: The island's most un-Ibizan winter night: a Swiss fondue under the vines with a band playing, out towards Es Canar. Book — the locals know.

where.n: La Finca Can Suldat, Es Canar

name: Bunyols on Tots Sants
desc: Sugar-dusted pumpkin and potato doughnuts, fried in the village squares and bakeries for All Saints. Eat them warm with a glass of sweet wine.

where.n: Village bakeries, Sant Josep & Santa Eulària

name: Matances & sobrassada
desc: Pig-slaughter season in the countryside: families make sobrassada and botifarró, and a few fincas and restaurants open the ritual to guests, with a feast of arròs de matances to finish.

where.n: Ask us — private matances by invitation

name: Sant Antoni bonfires & Flaming Pigs
desc: Foguerons the night before, the blessing of animals in the morning, and the sweet-sour smell of torrades across the town. The island's biggest winter fiesta.

name: Hierbas, the island's own
desc: Every bar has its bottle, every family its recipe: aniseed and a fistful of island herbs left to macerate for months. Best drunk ice-cold after lunch at a bar that makes its own.

name: Winter concerts in the fincas
desc: The small-venue season: jazz, flamenco and singer-songwriters in restaurants that keep their stage going when the clubs close.
